De La Hoghe · Chapter No. 1089

Joining & enquiries

Start with a conversation. We are happy to help you find out more.

Who can join?

Applicants must have been Master Masons for at least six months at the time of Perfection and be in good standing with their current and previous Craft units.

What is involved?

De La Hoghe meets three times each year, in February, April and October. The 18° regalia consists of a collar and jewel. Members generally attend in lounge suits with a non-Masonic tie.

Our Recorder can explain the Chapter’s subscriptions, dining charges and regalia arrangements before you decide to apply.
